about: Challenge rules as published by each firm, read on the date shown. Every value is backed by a quote from the firm's own rules page, under that page's rules heading; a value the page does not state is "not stated". Quotes are data, not page copy. Firm names are plain-text descriptors; donttrade is not affiliated with any firm and is paid by none. Re-check with checks/check_rules.py --online.
